card.name: Joints inside handles, ranges and codes
card.fires_on: Joining pieces such as hyphens, dashes or bars inside number ranges (page ranges, age ranges), and partway through handles, URLs and drug name suffixes like -kcqx.

modes.label: Number range dash
modes.description: A hyphen or dash between two numbers in page or age ranges, right before the second number.

modes.label: Inside handles and web addresses
modes.description: A piece in the middle of a social handle or web address.
modes.example: Follow Zerlina Maxwell on Twitter at @<<zer>>linamaxwell

modes.label: Biologic drug suffix
modes.description: The hyphen before the four-letter suffix in a biologic drug name.
modes.example: ulimab-kcqx, including Grade 2 (7%) and Grade 1 (12%) adverse reactions. Penpulimab<<-k>>cqx was withheld in 1.

card.writes: No clear output effect; the promoted pieces are mixed word endings and the suppressed ones are number words like Fifty and Forty.
card.plain: It fires on the joint in the middle of a range, handle or name, where the next piece is a number or an odd code.
